portal_hypertension.title: Incidental intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma detected in the explant liver after living-donor liver transplantation for polycystic liver disease.
portal_hypertension.authors: Asanuma S, Haruki K, Furukawa K
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：活体肝移植（LDLT）被考虑用于治疗伴有门脉高压或生活质量恶化的多囊肝病（PLD）。 临床提示：然而，PLD 中伴随恶性肿瘤的情况极为罕见。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Living-donor liver transplantation (LDLT) is considered for polycystic liver disease (PLD) with portal hypertension or quality of life deterioration. However, concomitant malignant tumors are extremely rare in PLD. The recipient was a 68-year-old female who had been followed for PLD. She developed progressive jaundice with ascites and lower leg edema. Computed tomography revealed portal hypertension with intrahepatic portal vein stenosis and splenorenal shunt. The liver was replaced by numerous cysts, but no obvious tumorous lesions were identified. Tumor markers were CEA of 7.9 ng/ml and CA19-9 of 420 U/ml.
